chore: cover comparator normalization (#917)

## Summary
- Add regression fixtures and integration coverage for comparator
whitespace, equality boundaries, and malformed loose alternatives.
- Cover long prerelease identifiers, build-metadata normalization, and
existing version limits across strict/loose and prerelease options.
- Tests only; no production behavior changes.

## Stack
First of two stacked PRs; followed by #918. Contains only commit
1eda6b48b211d87b9f5857a6e53361abe7622ef8. Merge this PR before the
performance implementation.

## Validation
Full `npm test` (including coverage, ESLint, and template checks) passes
on the combined stack.
